meta.name: ssr-hydration-scraping
meta.description: Best practices for extracting data from modern React/Vue SSR pages (like Next.js or Nuxt.js) by targeting hydration state blocks (__NEXT_DATA__, __NUXT__) using regex and `jmespath`, avoiding brittle DOM selector scraping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 SSR 页面提取结构化数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从 Next.js 或 Nuxt.js 页面获取内嵌数据
copy.tagline_en: Extract structured data from SSR pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to retrieve embedded data from Next.js or Nuxt.js pages

howto.what: Claude 会从 HTML 中提取 Next.js（__NEXT_DATA__）、Nuxt.js（__NUXT__）等 SSR 数据块，并用 jmespath 进行结构化查询，避免解析脆弱的 DOM 类名。
howto.when: 当用户提供现代前端框架（如 Next.js、Nuxt.js）的 HTML 页面，并要求从中提取数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这段 Next.js 页面的 HTML 中提取文章列表。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts SSR data blocks (__NEXT_DATA__, __NUXT__, __INITIAL_STATE__) from HTML using regex and queries them with jmespath, avoiding brittle DOM class names.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides HTML from modern frameworks (Next.js, Nuxt.js) and asks to extract data from it.

say_en.text: Extract the article list from this Next.js HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will extract __NEXT_DATA__ and parse the list.

say_en.text: Query payload.data[0].list using jmespath in Nuxt data.
say_en.note: It will sniff the path and return the list.
